title: Keepsakes from Below
blurb: Each region under the world has something of its own you can take home and set down.

steps.text: Find root amber in the Rootways.
steps.hint: Look on the floor under the root curtains: old resin lies there in small orange beads.

steps.text: Pick up cave pearls in the Pale Halls.
steps.hint: They form in the puddles under the drips in the limestone halls.

steps.text: Take a length of the Delvers' old rope in the Windcleft.
steps.hint: The old Delvers left their ropes hanging in the cracks.

steps.text: Take a piece of driftwood from the Drowned Galleries.
steps.hint: It washes up on the shores of the flooded halls' lakes.

steps.text: Break a crystal off a wall in the Glimmer Hollows.
steps.hint: Amber crystals under the hot lands, glacial ones under the cold.

steps.text: Cut ember lichen in the Ochre Deep.
steps.hint: It glows on the walls by the floor. Shears cut it free; it still glows at home.

steps.text: Pick up a Hollow's shed shell in the Violet Deep.
steps.hint: The Hollows shed their shells on the floors of the violet chambers.

finish.line: You've a keepsake from every region that has one.
